project.name: common-lib
project.description:
The platform's shared Java code, built as one reactor. The layout:
platform-bom the versions of every in-house library (imported by platform-parent) platform-parent the parent of every service and library: Spring Boot, imported BOMs, pins, plugins common-core framework-free: credential rules, service contracts, the response envelope, errors common-web the Spring MVC side: security filters, scope, cache, encryption, error handling, OpenAPI common-messaging the RabbitMQ side: activity and notification publishers, the activity outbox
`mvn -f common-lib/pom.xml install` builds and installs all five. This pom aggregates only: it is nobody's parent and holds no dependencies or plugins.
